backend/main.mo: Canister defines memory storage, user profiles, Valentine states, and access-controlled methods for adding, updating, and querying data. Includes publishing toggle, authorization mixins, and storage integration.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old actor state to new format by adding isPublished field to memories. Returns updated actor state with preserved data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented frontend files, related components, and test coverage for sharing and public memories features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries describing major frontend files, including hooks, components, configuration, and UI behaviors.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining Valentine-themed color variables, dark mode overrides, and base styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting page metadata and loading main React bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component initializing React Query and conditionally rendering share mode or main Valentine app shell based on URL params.
frontend/src/components/animation/Sectio: Adds a delayed visibility animation to wrapped content, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Shows a dialog prompting authenticated users without a profile to enter their name and save it.
frontend/src/components/CelebrationOverl: Animated celebration overlay showing confetti, sparkles, and hearts with reduced-motion support and auto-close behavior.
frontend/src/components/feedback/AccessR: Displays a card informing users that sign-in is required, optionally showing a login button.
frontend/src/components/InitialBackgroun: Component rendering animated gradient particles with reduced-motion fallback.
frontend/src/components/InitialFloatingH: Component rendering floating animated heart emojis with reduced-motion fallback.
Provides the main app layout with header, login controls, welcome text, and profile setup dialog.
frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts: Defines static Valentine-themed UI text, assets, and configuration values used across the app.
frontend/src/features/animations/Animati: Empty placeholder file for the animations feature page.
frontend/src/features/games/GamesPage.ts: Empty placeholder file for the games feature page.
frontend/src/features/games/gameStyles.c: Empty stylesheet placeholder for game-related styles.
frontend/src/features/games/StickerMemor: Empty placeholder file for the sticker memory match game.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoriesG: Shows a grid of memory photos with captions and dates and opens a detail dialog when clicked.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoriesP: Empty placeholder file for the memories page.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoryDet: Displays a dialog showing full memory details including image, timestamps, and loading states.
frontend/src/features/memories/MemoryUpl: Provides UI for selecting, previewing, and uploading a memory photo with progress tracking.
frontend/src/features/memories/PublishSh: Manages publishing of memories and provides a shareable public link with copy-to-clipboard support.
frontend/src/features/memories/SharedMem: Displays a grid of publicly shared memories and opens a detail dialog on selection.
Displays a gallery of published shared memories with loading, error, and empty states, plus a footer attribution.
Modal dialog that loads and shows details for a single published memory including image and timestamps.
frontend/src/features/valentine/Valentin: Main Valentine-themed landing page with greeting customization, evasive button logic, celebration overlay, and personal memories integration.
frontend/src/features/warning/WarningPag: Deprecated warning-entry page that shows a risk notice and transitions to a simple placeholder once acknowledged.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvasiveButton.ts: Hook that repositions a button to avoid user interaction, providing escape logic and interaction handlers.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, loading stored identities, handling login/logout, and exposing identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMemories.ts: Provides React Query hooks to list, add, and fetch individual user photo memories via the actor API with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSharedMemories.ts: Offers hooks to fetch all published memories or a specific published memory through the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useSharePublishing.ts: Contains hooks to list all memories and toggle their published state, invalidating related queries after updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Implements hooks for retrieving and updating the caller's user profile and personalized greeting, with appropriate query invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and a Valentine-themed design system with custom colors, animations, and layout classes.
frontend/src/lib/fileToExternalBlob.ts: Converts a File into an ExternalBlob and optionally wraps it with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/lib/time.ts: Formats bigint timestamps into readable dates and returns the current time as a bigint in nanoseconds.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers to read, persist, and clear URL parameters, supporting both query-string and hash-based routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, radii, plugins, and Valentine-themed extensions.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, feature requests, issues, and state for the public memory sharing project.
